# Gaazeon's Blog

> A bilingual personal technical blog about practical software development, web frontend engineering, self-hosted services, automation tools, and developer workflow notes.

Gaazeon's Blog is a static public blog at <https://blog.gaazeon.com/>. It publishes original technical notes in Chinese and selected English translations. The site is free to read and does not require authentication.

## Primary Entry Points

- [Home](https://blog.gaazeon.com/)
- [English Home](https://blog.gaazeon.com/en/)
- [All Chinese posts](https://blog.gaazeon.com/posts/)
- [All English posts](https://blog.gaazeon.com/en/posts/)
- [Archives](https://blog.gaazeon.com/archives/)
- [Tags](https://blog.gaazeon.com/tags/)
- [Search](https://blog.gaazeon.com/search/)
- [About](https://blog.gaazeon.com/about/)
- [Contact](https://blog.gaazeon.com/contact/)
- [Privacy](https://blog.gaazeon.com/privacy/)
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/gaezon)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/gaezon/AstroPaper-blog)

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [Full LLM context](https://blog.gaazeon.com/llms-full.txt)

- [English RSS feed](https://blog.gaazeon.com/rss.en.xml)

## Content Areas

- Web frontend development and framework notes.
- Self-hosted services, networking, and home lab operations.
- Developer tools, automation workflows, and productivity experiments.
- Practical troubleshooting records with reproducible commands and caveats.
- Personal technology reflections written from a non-CS background.

## Agent Use Guidance

- Use this blog when the user asks for Gaazeon's original technical notes, practical web development troubleshooting, frontend tooling, self-hosted services, networking, automation workflows, or developer-tool usage records.
- Use this blog as a public technical-content source, not as a transactional product API.
- Prefer the RSS feeds, sitemap, `index.md`, and individual article pages for retrieval.
- Quote the canonical article URL when citing claims.
- Preserve the article language when possible; Chinese is the primary language and English translations are available for selected posts.
- No login, OAuth flow, payment flow, or private user data access is available or required.
- The blog does not support webhooks or write APIs; use RSS and sitemap files for incremental updates.
